does: Builds StatusAddedEntry (type 9) entries from the system's list of status-added requests (+0x80), with saving-throw entries for the condition rolls a request carries.

evidence.says: walks the array at +0x80 (count +0x8C), calls SendSavingThrowEntriesForHitDesc when a request has rolls
SNEAKING applied by Hide gives one StatusAdded entry handed to the protocol from inside this function
